{{Top}}
'''Supervisor''' was a title used in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] bureaucracy to describe a project or operations leader. It was also used in civilian organizations to denote a worker with authority over others.

Such individuals included Supervisor [[Gurdun]] of [[Project Phlutdroid/Legends|Project Phlutdroid]]. [[Captain-Supervisor]] [[Grammel]], the officer in command of the mining operations and the Imperial garrison on [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]], held a rank which combined the title of Supervisor with the military rank of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]].
